name: Fan Hongwei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Hurun China (2015-2026); Hurun Self-Made Women (2018-2025)
forbes_bio: Fan Hongwei is the chairman of Hengli Petrochemical, the main listed arm of Hengli Group.
Her husband Chen Jianhua, also a billionaire, is the chairman of the parent company.
Fan worked as an accountant before establishing a textile and silk trading business with Chen.
The couple later acquired a state-owned chemical fiber factory and expanded into petrochemicals.
The couple's son, Chen Hanlun, is a director and general manager of Guangdong Songfa Ceramics. Their daughter, Chen Yiting, is Hengli Group's vice president.

name: Dmitry Nikolaev
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Nikolaev controls coal producer Stroyservis.
In the early 1990s the company traded metals and pipes, then invested in coal mines.
Stroyservis is 6st coal producer in Russia. Company produces coking and thermal coke and coke chemistry.

Head office of Stroyservis is located in Kemerovo (Kuzbass, Siberia). Kuzbass or Kuznetsk Basin is one of the largest coal areas in the world. Overall coal deposits of Kuzbass are estimated at 700 billion tons.
Every year Stroyservis entered into agreement on social and economic cooperation with the administration of the Kemerovo region. Company supports local hospitals and schools.
forbes_facts: Stroyservis is the main sponsor of the Muay Thai Federation of Russia.
Stroyservis publishes on its website "world records" of production achievements of employees.?

name: Daniel Roberts
forbes_bio: Brothers Daniel and William Roberts cofounded Nasdaq-listed IREN, which builds data centers for AI and high performance computing.
They are both co-CEOs of the Sydney-headquartered company, which was listed on NASDAQ in November 2021.
IREN is building a 1,800-acre, 2 gigawatt AI data center in Sweetwater, Texas, about 230 miles from Dallas.
The company's client list includes Microsoft, which signed a five-year AI cloud services contract worth $9.7 billion in 2025.
The brothers worked with investment bank Macquarie in Sydney advising on capital markets, infrastructure and renewable energy, before striking out on their own.

name: Liu Ming Hui
forbes_bio: Liu Ming Hui is the chairman and cofounder of China Gas Holdings,  a natural gas services operator listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
Liu is a graduate of China's Hebei Normal University.
Liu's brother Liu Mingxing and daughter Liu Chang sit on China Gas Holding's board.
